remarks: Best-Priced Condo in Norwalk! Move-in ready and filled with natural light, this inviting condo offers blue-sky views from every window, wonderful privacy, and a comfortable, welcoming feel. The updated kitchen features handsome wood cabinetry and newer stainless-steel appliances, while the bathroom was tastefully updated in 2021. Enjoy the convenience of a reserved parking space right at your front door, abundant closet space throughout the unit, plus a dedicated storage space for the unit in the building. Low HOA fees include heat and hot water, making this an exceptional value in Fairfield County.  Conveniently located near Stew Leonard's, with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, this home offers an ideal combination of comfort, value, and convenience. A fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors-don't miss your chance to make this home yours!
